wins.text: Net income of $15B, EPS of $5.24, ROTCE of 21% on revenue of $45.7B for Q2-2025
Markets revenue up 15% YoY to ~$5.5B; Fixed Income up 14%, Equities up 15% with strong derivatives performance
CIB net income of $6.7B on revenue of $19.5B, up 9% YoY; IB fees up 7% YoY with #1 wallet share at 8.9%
AWM AUM reached $4.3T, up 18% YoY; long-term net inflows of $31B; pretax margin of 34%
NII ex Markets guidance raised to ~$92B (total NII ~$95.5B), up from prior guidance, driven by forward curve changes and strong deposit growth

risks.text: Firm revenue of $45.7B was down $5.3B or 10% YoY, largely due to absence of prior-year Visa-related gains and net investment securities losses
CET1 ratio declined 40 bps QoQ to 15% as capital distributions and higher RWA more than offset net income; RWA expansion driven by wholesale lending and Card loan growth
Macro and tariff uncertainty remains elevated; management explicitly noted 'all the tail risks are still there quite prominently' and pipeline visibility is limited
Adjusted expense guidance raised to ~$95.5B, primarily driven by weaker dollar impact, adding cost pressure
Home Lending revenue down 5% YoY on lower NII; nonperforming asset uptick in consumer driven by LA wildfire forbearance, though loss expectation described as de minimis

guidance_items.detail: NII ex Markets raised to ~$92B; total NII guidance raised to ~$95.5B (implying $3.5B Markets NII), up from prior Investor Day guidance
Card net charge-off rate guidance unchanged at approximately 3.6%
Adjusted expense guidance raised to ~$95.5B, primarily driven by weaker dollar impact — directionally a cost increase vs. prior guidance

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Stablecoin/tokenized deposit strategy and interoperability with non-JPM customers — not mentioned in prepared remarks
Valuation constraint on buybacks (stock near 3x tangible book) and whether CET1 growth can be arrested — not proactively addressed
Sapphire card annual fee increase and competitive response — not mentioned in prepared remarks
